description: Header file defining the QuicheDataReader class for reading binary data from buffers, supporting various data types and byte orders.

classes.name: QuicheDataReader
classes.description: A class for reading various data types from a byte buffer with support for endianness and position tracking.

methods.name: ReadUInt8
methods.description: Reads an 8-bit unsigned integer from the buffer.

methods.name: ReadUInt16
methods.description: Reads a 16-bit unsigned integer from the buffer.

methods.name: ReadUInt24
methods.description: Reads a 24-bit unsigned integer from the buffer.

methods.name: ReadUInt32
methods.description: Reads a 32-bit unsigned integer from the buffer.

methods.name: ReadUInt64
methods.description: Reads a 64-bit unsigned integer from the buffer.

methods.name: ReadBytesToUInt64
methods.description: Reads a specified number of bytes and interprets them as a uint64 in the correct byte order.

methods.name: ReadStringPiece16
methods.description: Reads a length-prefixed string with 16-bit length.

methods.name: ReadStringPiece8
methods.description: Reads a length-prefixed string with 8-bit length.

methods.name: ReadStringPiece
methods.description: Reads a specified number of bytes into a string view.

methods.name: ReadTag
methods.description: Reads a 32-bit tag in big endian order.

methods.name: ReadDecimal64
methods.description: Reads a fixed number of decimal digits and parses as uint64.

methods.name: PeekVarInt62Length
methods.description: Returns the length in bytes of the next variable length integer.

methods.name: ReadVarInt62
methods.description: Reads a 62-bit variable length integer.

methods.name: ReadStringPieceVarInt62
methods.description: Reads a string prefixed with a 62-bit variable length integer.

methods.name: ReadRemainingPayload
methods.description: Returns the remaining buffer as a string view, referencing the underlying data.

methods.name: PeekRemainingPayload
methods.description: Returns the remaining payload without advancing the internal position.

methods.name: FullPayload
methods.description: Returns the entire buffer as a string view.

methods.name: PreviouslyReadPayload
methods.description: Returns the part of the buffer that has already been read.

methods.name: ReadBytes
methods.description: Reads a specified number of bytes into a provided buffer.

methods.name: Seek
methods.description: Skips over a specified number of bytes.

methods.name: IsDoneReading
methods.description: Checks if the entire buffer has been read.

methods.name: BytesRemaining
methods.description: Returns the number of bytes left to read.

methods.name: TruncateRemaining
methods.description: Reduces the remaining data to a specified length.

methods.name: PeekByte
methods.description: Returns the next byte to be read without advancing the position.

methods.name: DebugString
methods.description: Returns a debug string representing the internal state.
